requirements.evidence: Schema and contract are all present: `database/migrations/2026_10_29_064255_create_entities_table.php:21` (`entities_slug_unique`), `database/migrations/2026_10_29_064256_create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-27` (`owner_seq` storedAs plus `entity_memberships_entity_user_unique` and `entity_memberships_one_owner`), `app/Models/Entity.php:22-25,42-47,54-57`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:35-54,61-74`, `app/Models/User.php:47-49`, `app/Models/UserRole.php:5-19`, `app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:14-62`, `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-46`, factories `database/factories/EntityFactory.php:17-24` and `database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:20-52`. Deviation: `assignRole` refuses every change on the owner membership (`app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:23-27`), an exception the task does not state (it only forbids deleting the owner's membership).

conventions.evidence: Generated migration style with reversible `down()` (`database/migrations/2026_10_29_064255_create_entities_table.php:12-31`), deliberate mass-assignment protection with `#[Fillable]` (`app/Models/Entity.php:13`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12`), authorization in `app/Policies`, sibling-style docblocks (`app/Models/User.php:22-49`), docs and CHANGELOG updated (`docs/database-schema.md:31-36,87-96,139`, `CHANGELOG.md:9`). Docs-freshness deviation: the schema doc still promises an ownership transfer that demotes the current owner (`docs/database-schema.md:150`) while `assignRole` now rejects exactly that.

security.evidence: Every ability is authorized against DB-backed memberships (`app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:22-24,30-32,38-40,46-48`; `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-16,23-27,33-40`), with non-members denied and the owner membership undeletable (`app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:35-37`); `users()`/`entities()` pivots expose only `role`; `$fillable` is explicit (`app/Models/Entity.php:13`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12`). No user input, output rendering or client-controlled IDs in this change, so no validation/escaping surface is missed.

tests.evidence: Four Pest files exercise models, relations, scopes, casts, factories (`tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:1-112`), allow and deny paths for both policies (`tests/Feature/EntityPolicyTest.php:1-64`, `tests/Feature/EntityMembershipPolicyTest.php:1-76`) and DB invariants including duplicate slug, one membership per user/entity, one owner per entity, owner_seq values, column default and both cascade paths (`tests/Feature/EntitySchemaTest.php:1-101`). Gaps: only `entities_slug_unique` is asserted by name (`tests/Feature/EntitySchemaTest.php:13-19`), while the two required membership index names are only tested by behaviour; and there is no test that soft-deleting an entity keeps its memberships as the doc claims.

simplicity.evidence: Lean implementation: three one-line local scopes (`app/Models/EntityMembership.php:35-54`), `owner()` reuses `memberships()->owner()` (`app/Models/Entity.php:54-57`), both policies reuse `User::membershipFor()` (`app/Models/User.php:47-49`), factories use plain `state()` (`database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:30-52`); no service/repository layer, no speculative abstraction or duplicated persistence code.

readability.evidence: Clear names and short focused methods throughout (`app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:14-62`, `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-46`); docblocks explain each ability, relation and scope (`app/Models/Entity.php:37-57`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:32-54`); style matches siblings such as `app/Models/User.php:22-49`; no dead code, debug output or leftover scaffolding.

scope.evidence: All application code and tests serve the task. The only unrelated edit is dropping the unimplemented `locale_default` field from the entities ER block (`docs/database-schema.md:31-36`), which the task did not request (it only asked to replace `owner_membership_id`).

issues.explanation: assignRole additionally returns false whenever the target membership is the owner, narrowing the task's rule that owner and admin may assign roles; the only owner-specific restriction the task states is that the owner's membership cannot be deleted.

The updated doc says ownership transfer must demote the current owner before promoting another member, but the new policy rejects any role assignment on the owner membership, so the documentation and the code disagree.

Only entities_slug_unique is asserted by name; the task explicitly names entity_memberships_entity_user_unique and entity_memberships_one_owner, and those names are never checked (only their behaviour is).

There is no test that soft-deleting an entity preserves its memberships, even though the revised schema doc states that memberships are only removed when the entity is force-deleted or the user is deleted.
The diff also removes the unimplemented locale_default field from the entities ER block, which is outside the task's documented reason for editing this file.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership schema (including the portable owner_seq unique trick), models, enum, factories, policies, docs and a solid Pest suite. It is close to mergeable; the main points are the unrequested owner exemption in assignRole (which also contradicts the ownership-transfer note in the updated docs) and minor test gaps around the named membership indexes.
